description: This Java source file defines the GestureListener class, which extends GestureDetector.SimpleOnGestureListener to handle various touch gestures such as taps, long presses, scrolls, flings, and double taps. It includes detailed logging for each gesture type and methods to interpret touch tool types and button presses. The class is part of an Android project related to gesture detection.

classes.name: GestureListener
classes.description: A listener class that extends SimpleOnGestureListener to handle gesture callbacks and log detailed information about user interactions.

methods.name: onSingleTapUp
methods.description: Handles the single tap up gesture and logs the event with touch type details.

methods.name: onLongPress
methods.description: Handles long press gesture detection and logs the event.

methods.name: onScroll
methods.description: Handles scroll gestures and logs the event.

methods.name: onFling
methods.description: Handles fling gestures and logs the event.

methods.name: onShowPress
methods.description: Handles the show press gesture (user has touched but not moved).

methods.name: onDown
methods.description: Handles the initial touch down event and logs it.

methods.name: onDoubleTap
methods.description: Handles double tap gestures and logs the event.

methods.name: onDoubleTapEvent
methods.description: Handles individual events within a double tap gesture.

methods.name: getTouchType
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string describing the tool type (finger, stylus, etc.) associated with a MotionEvent.

methods.name: getButtonsPressed
methods.description: Returns a string listing all stylus buttons pressed during the MotionEvent; only used if SDK version >= 21.
